Matrix free linear solve with implicit differentiation

Source: R/lax_control.R
lax_custom_linear_solve.Rd

Port of jax.lax.custom_linear_solve. Gradients are defined by implicit differentiation at the solution instead of differentiating through solve.

Usage

lax_custom_linear_solve(
  matvec,
  b,
  solve,
  transpose_solve = NULL,
  symmetric = FALSE,
  has_aux = FALSE
)

Arguments

matvec

Linear function computing A x.

b

Right hand side (pytree).

solve

Function (matvec, b) returning x with matvec(x) == b.

transpose_solve

Function (vecmat, b) solving the transposed system; needed for reverse mode unless symmetric.

symmetric

Whether the linear map is symmetric.

has_aux

Whether solve returns list(x, aux).
